goal: Scope and build plugins/pmcro-aspire: a PMCR-O skill wrapping the .NET Aspire MCP server as a live evidence source for Maker/Checker, reusing the already-recorded research from trail ba0c2c65 rather than re-deriving it.

steps.action: Scope plugins/pmcro-aspire following the existing plugin conventions (plugin.json + .claude-plugin/plugin.json, agents/aspire.md with role/tier, skills/gather-evidence/SKILL.md + assets + references), reusing the exact 14-tool catalog and setup steps already recorded in trail ba0c2c65 rather than re-researching.

Write the plugin: agents/aspire.md (tier EVIDENCE, read-only, supplies evidence to Maker/Checker on request, never authors a MakeStep/CheckFrame itself); skills/gather-evidence/SKILL.md plus assets/setup, assets/tools, assets/recipe, references/README documenting registration (aspire agent init / aspire agent mcp), the tool catalog, and how Maker/Checker fold tool output into trail evidence.

Register pmcro-aspire in all four marketplace manifests (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json) so it is discoverable the same way as the other six plugins.

Validate all four manifest JSON files plus both new plugin.json files parse cleanly, and confirm every plugin file referenced by plugin.json (agents/aspire.md, skills/gather-evidence/SKILL.md and its assets) actually exists on disk.
Commit and push the new plugin and manifest updates.
